_note: Predictive Sandbox R&D content. Family: disruption. Texture: interference, breaking of routine, sudden stops, or scattered logistics. Routes heavily on dominant_operation=disrupt, semantic_state, and pass_state.

entries.title: Active Interference With the Line
entries.body: The dominant pressure is to disrupt, and the underlying signals are actively opposed to one another. This isn't just a dropped signal or a delayed shipment; it's a direct, competing force actively interfering with the established routine. Systems are likely to jam if forced.
entries.notes: disrupt + opposed: aggressive logistical or material failure.

entries.title: The Rhythm Starts to Stutter
entries.body: The exact disruption has not yet hit its peak, but the approach is already rattling the baseline. Expect early warning signs—scheduling conflicts, minor equipment faults, or sudden unavailability of key resources—that signal the normal flow is about to be interrupted.
entries.notes: disrupt + APPROACH: the lead-up to a break in routine.

entries.title: A Grinding Halt in the Routine
entries.body: The disruption here is characterized by friction. Things aren't necessarily exploding, they are simply refusing to move forward smoothly. It is the texture of driving with the parking brake engaged—everything takes twice as much energy and yields half the result.
entries.notes: disrupt + frictional: delays, drag, and inefficiency.

entries.title: The Disruption Formalizes Itself
entries.body: This window marks the point where a disruption stops being a temporary emergency and becomes the new formalized reality. A broken agreement is officially terminated, a halted process is officially canceled. The chaos resolves into a concrete, recognizable state.
entries.notes: disrupt + RESOLUTION: the end of the disruption cycle, finalizing the break.
